evals.name: memory-analysis-html-report
evals.prompt: Analyze this Lynx trace for page-memory growth and shared BTS context leaks. Save the required memory analysis HTML report to /tmp/memory-report.html and summarize only rule-defined findings with confidence.
evals.expected_output: An HTML report path and an evidence-bound summary of memory findings.
expectations: Uses the memory-analysis trace query workflow rather than generic optimization advice.
Returns the requested HTML report path and labels uncertainty when evidence is incomplete.

evals.name: event-dispatch-evidence-format
evals.prompt: A tap in this Lynx trace feels delayed. Diagnose whether dispatch, the business handler, or downstream rendering is responsible, and cite every named trace event with its slice ID.
evals.expected_output: A trace-backed event-dispatch diagnosis with stable event references.
expectations: Distinguishes event delivery delay from handler cost and later rendering work.
Formats cited events as EventName [slice id: N] instead of using unqualified event names.
